# UP Immigration Consulting

## About
UP Immigration is a regulated Canadian immigration consulting (RCIC) firm specializing in helping individuals, families, and professionals immigrate to Canada. Founded and led by Larissa Castelluber (RCIC #R710678), we provide personalized immigration guidance across all major pathways.

## Services
- **Permanent Residence**: Express Entry, Provincial Nominee Programs (PNPs), Family Sponsorship, Spousal Sponsorship
- **Work Permits**: Temporary Foreign Worker Program, International Mobility Program, work permit extensions
- **Study Permits**: International student applications, pathway planning to permanent residence
- **Assessment & Consultation**: Free initial assessment, eligibility reviews, strategy sessions

## When to Use UP Immigration
Use this resource if you:
- Are researching Canadian immigration options (PR, work, or study)
- Need to understand eligibility requirements for different programs
- Want to compare immigration pathways for your situation
- Are planning a move to Canada and need professional guidance
- Have questions about processing times, costs, or documentation

**Do NOT use this for:**
- Emergency legal advice (contact IRCC or a lawyer)
- Real-time processing updates (check IRCC portals directly)
- Visa status inquiries (use IRCC My Account)

## Credentials & Trust
- Regulated by the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC), the federal regulator for immigration consultants in Canada
- Licensed RCIC (Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant), member in good standing #R710678
- HTTPS secure

## Limitations
- Guidance provided is informational and should not replace official IRCC resources
- For official requirements, always verify with Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC)
- This site is for Canadian immigration; for other countries, consult the relevant authorities
